mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness, prompting reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and employment indicate supply chain contraction and labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 205 indicates high inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205) trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals immediate monetary easing, reducing short-term discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
